scope: six source candidates admitted at documentation level only; root coordinates source archives
basis: Found six previously unrepresented core capabilities in old16; no app-per-bench or genre-quota requirement

selected_candidates.name: GNOME Calculator
selected_candidates.build_requirements: Meson>=0.57; C/Vala; GTK4>=4.11.4; Adwaita>=1.4.alpha; GtkSourceView>=5.3; Soup>=3.4; Gee>=0.20; MPC/MPFR. 46.3 selected for Ubuntu24.04 compatibility, 51.0 retained as too-new candidate.
selected_candidates.source_caveats: Ubuntu24.04 baseline comparison suggests build feasible; no build/run proof. Exact apt packages, fonts, locale and all transitive dependencies must still be fixed. Currency rate fetching excluded from offline tasks.

workflows.name: 表达式与错误恢复
workflows.observe: 在基本/高级模式键入2+3×4与带括号变体、删除重输和非法表达式，记录结果与错误标识
workflows.implement: 独立实现输入buffer、运算优先级、错误态与清除/纠正路径
workflows.check: 同数值输入的键盘与按钮结果一致；非法输入不返回虚假有效值，改正后恢复
workflows.negative_example: 只拼接按钮文本或以从左至右求值冒充优先级
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted

workflows.name: 数值模式与历史
workflows.observe: 观察角度单位/数值进制切换与历史条目复用，记录显示和值的变化
workflows.implement: 分开数值、格式、角度模式和历史，切换格式不破坏数值
workflows.check: 已知角度与整数进制fixture符合参考结果；历史重新选用可再次计算
workflows.negative_example: 将格式后的字符串当实际数值，切换模式重置或污染历史
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted

selected_candidates.name: Tad
selected_candidates.build_requirements: Official source build: Node19.3/npm9.2 documentation, Lerna bootstrap and build-all.sh, desktop Electron31.0.1 and DuckDB; native dependencies and old node-sass require fixed versions.
selected_candidates.source_caveats: Windows2022 build is not verified; use controlled packaged runtime or admitted node/native toolchain. Only local CSV/Parquet fixture; cloud SQL backends excluded; updater/DuckDB extension auto-fetch must be disabled or precached and verified offline.

workflows.name: 过滤排序与真实导出
workflows.observe: 导入含稳定ID、文本、数字、空值的CSV，单列过滤、数值排序、取消条件，再导出可见表
workflows.implement: 独立建模source行、视图条件、排序与输出行集
workflows.check: 输出CSV/Parquet解码后ID集合/顺序/空值与公开界面一致；取消过滤恢复全部行
workflows.negative_example: 只隐藏行而导出全表、数字按字符串排序、空值当零
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted

workflows.name: 透视聚合与列状态
workflows.observe: 观察按类别分组、总计/数量、展开折叠、选列与列顺序
workflows.implement: 独立实现聚合层与显示状态，避免把汇总值再次计入
workflows.check: 对小fixture人工确定组数/总计；展开不改总计、隐藏列不改源数据
workflows.negative_example: 只画相同表头或将聚合结果叠加重复计算
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted

selected_candidates.name: KReversi
selected_candidates.license: GPL-2.0-or-later code; GFDL docs and separately licensed themes/assets
selected_candidates.build_requirements: CMake>=3.16; Qt6>=6.5 Widgets/Qml/Quick/QuickWidgets/Svg; ECM/KF6>=6.0 and KDEGames6. Source tag26.08.1 is fixed; future Ubuntu24 package/Flatpak runtime must include KDE6 stack.
selected_candidates.source_caveats: Stock Ubuntu24.04 KDE5 packages are insufficient for this fixed modern KDE6 source; use pinned official KDE6 runtime/dependency container. QML board accessibility and deterministic human-vs-human mode require admission. Computer AI timing/choice excluded from deterministic first workflows.

workflows.name: 合法与非法落子
workflows.observe: 在人对人模式观察合法提示、合法落子的连续翻子、非法格点击与当前玩家
workflows.implement: 独立实现board状态和方向捕获规则，不从截图颜色硬编码下一盘
workflows.check: 固定初始局面合法/非法路径中棋子数、翻转集合和turn一致；非法行动不改变状态
workflows.negative_example: 允许所有空格或只翻一个邻居、无合法动作仍强制玩家落子
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted

workflows.name: 撤销与新局隔离
workflows.observe: 观察多步后撤销、提示开关与重新开始
workflows.implement: 实现完整状态历史与reset，提示只是视图
workflows.check: 撤销恢复棋盘/分数/turn；新局清除旧history且再次首步不受上一盘污染
workflows.negative_example: 只撤销最后一个落子不恢复翻子、reset保留旧轮次
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted

selected_candidates.name: Veusz
selected_candidates.build_requirements: Python>=3.8, Qt>=6.3, SIP>=6.5, PyQt>=6.3 and NumPy per fixed INSTALL; C++ helper extensions and setuptools build. FITS/HDF5 are optional. Scope localCSV,2Dplot,SVG/PNG export.
selected_candidates.source_caveats: Ubuntu24.04 Python/Qt baseline must be compared with exact pinned requirements; Qt6.10.2 in official binaries is not a requirement automatically satisfied by stock apt. Plotcanvas requires screenshots/coordinates; optional networking/data capture/plugins excluded.

workflows.name: 数据到图形映射
workflows.observe: 观察合成CSV列导入、X/Y分配、轴标题/范围、线与点样式
workflows.implement: 独立实现数据schema与plot坐标转换，分开widget树、数据与viewport
workflows.check: 小数据图点数量/坐标/标签与参考一致；改变轴范围只改变视图
workflows.negative_example: 凭初始图手绘曲线、混用列或缩放改数据
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted

workflows.name: 文档与导出一致性
workflows.observe: 编辑图层/标签后保存重开，导出SVG/PNG并改变输出尺寸
workflows.implement: 实现文档持久化和数据驱动导出
workflows.check: 重开保留dataset/轴/样式；解码输出尺寸与图形范围正确
workflows.negative_example: 只保存截图或工具条不是真实图内容，导出忽略最终修改
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted

selected_candidates.name: Pomotroid
selected_candidates.build_requirements: Tauri2/Rust2021/Svelte5; Node22+ per fixed CONTRIBUTING.md, npm and Rust/Cargo caches; native Windows MSVC/WebView2 or Ubuntu WebKitGTK4.1. Cargo includes bundledrusqlite/rodio/localwebsocket optionalserver.
selected_candidates.source_caveats: Windows2022 needs fixed MSVC and WebView2 runtime, neither build nor GUI admission performed; tray/notification must remain local to reference VM. Updater/network disabled; optional WebSocketserver not actor observation channel.

workflows.name: 暂停与继续的单一时钟
workflows.observe: 观察start、短等待、pause、等待、resume、reset时显示与进度弧
workflows.implement: 独立实现单一单调时间来源、running/paused/reset状态机
workflows.check: 暂停期间剩余值保持、继续接续同round；容许固定显示粒度误差，不用每render重开interval
workflows.negative_example: 暂停后后台仍倒计时或多interval让计时加倍
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted

workflows.name: 轮次边界与统计持久化
workflows.observe: 用公开设置的最短合法时长观察work→break、完成统计、重启记录
workflows.implement: 独立实现边界事件 exactlyonce、设置/会话状态与统计持久化
workflows.check: 一次完成只增加一次计数；重启统计保留，reset不伪造完成
workflows.negative_example: 达到零反复统计、暂停/放弃被记完成
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted

selected_candidates.name: Cozy
selected_candidates.license: GPL-3.0-or-later; bundled python-inject has its own includedlicense
selected_candidates.build_requirements: Python3/Meson>=0.40,GTK4>=4.10,Adwaita>=1.4,PyGObject/gi-cairo,Peewee>=3.9.6,Mutagen,GStreamer1.0 codecs. README has Ubuntu-specific DEVELOPMENT instructions.
selected_candidates.source_caveats: Declared GTK/Adwaita minima fit Ubuntu24.04 baseline; build/runtime not verified. Use synthetic local WAV chapters(no copyright/DRM/networkdrive); fixed GStreamer/audio sink, font/metadata library. macOS port discontinued, not selected.

workflows.name: 播放与寻址状态
workflows.observe: 导入两个合成WAV章节，观察play/pause/seek/切章、时长和进度
workflows.implement: 独立建模media身份、秒时间、playback状态和异步加载/seek
workflows.check: seek后声段/显示位置一致；暂停位置不推进，换章不会延用上一章时长
workflows.negative_example: 仅移动进度条而媒体没跳转、异步回执覆盖新章节
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted

workflows.name: 位置与库持久化
workflows.observe: 播放/seek后关闭重开、搜索过滤书目、更改播放速度并观察
workflows.implement: 实现每媒体独立bookmark、库状态和播放速率
workflows.check: 重开回到同章节与位置(允许固定误差)；过滤不删除库记录；速率不改文件时长
workflows.negative_example: 全库共用一个位置或搜索结果被误当已删除媒体
workflows.status: proposed public behavior; reference runtime observation and independent verifier not yet admitted
